comment: Frame 086, printed p. 70: the problem of frame 085 concluded (the seventh a hundred and sixty, the eighth a hundred and forty, eight hundred and twenty to the heirs). Then «باب آخر من الوصايا» in bold: when some heirs allow a bequest of more than a third and others do not: whoever allows it bears the excess in his share, and for whoever does not, the third holds in any case. «مثال ذلك» in bold: a woman leaves her husband, her son and her mother and bequeaths two fifths of her estate to one man and a quarter to another; the son allows both bequests, the mother half, the husband nothing beyond the third; the shares from twelve, seven to the son, three to the husband, two to the mother, continued on the next page. Below the rule one footnote of the editors.

lines.text: السبع مائة وستون والثمن مائة وأربعون وبقى ثمانمائة وعشرون سهما بين
الورثة على سهامهم . {b:باب آخر من الوصايا} وهو اذا لم يجز بعض الورثة وأجاز
بعضهم والوصية أكثر من الثلث . اعلم أن الحكم فى ذلك أن من أجاز من الورثة
أكثر من الثلث من الوصية فذلك داخل عليه فى حصته ومن لم يجز فالثلث
جايز عليه على كل حال . {b:مثال ذلك} إمرة ماتت وتركث زوجها وابنها وامها
وأوصت لرجل بخمسى مالها ولآخر بربع مالها فأجاز الابن الوصيتين جميعاً
وأجازت الأم النصف لهما ولم يجز الزوج شيئاً من ذلك الا الثلث {n:١} فقياس
ذلك أن تقيم سهام الفريضة فتجدها من اثنى عشر سهما . للابن من ذلك سبعة
أسهم وللزوج ثلاثة أسهم وللأم سهمان وأنت تعلم أن الزوج يجوز عليه الثلث
فينبغى أن يكون فى يده مثلا ما يخرج من حصته للوصايا وفى يده ثلاثة للوصايا

observations: L02 and L05: the words باب آخر من الوصايا (L02), the heading of a third chapter of the book of wills, and مثال ذلك (L05), which introduces its example, are printed in a bold face, run in after full stops; the words that follow are in the face of the text. The bold ن is printed without its dot; transcribed ن.

L05: «إمرة», as printed, with a hamza below the alif, for امرأة, a woman, which frame 085 prints with the hamza on the alif (L06); «جايز», as printed, with a dotted ي for the hamza of جائز. Both are transcribed as printed.

L05: «وتركث», as printed: the final letter carries three dots (8 by 7 px each, 3 to 9 px apart, nearest approach of the ink at 400 ppi), arranged as the dots of ث, where the same verb has a ت with two dots on frame 085, L06 (وتركت) and the ت of ماتت in this line has two. See the critical note AK01-CN024.
أكثر (L03, L04) is transcribed as one word; the print sets its ك 22 px from the alif in L03, as everywhere in this edition (frames 071 and 072).

Where the gap lies between the distances inside a word and those between words, a word space is transcribed: اذا لم (L02; 25 between the alif and the ل), لهما ولم (L07; 24 between the alif and the conjunction و), where an alif stands 2 to 17 px from the next letter without a space.

After a connecting letter, whose final form marks the end of the word, a word space is transcribed where the print sets the words close: بعضهم والوصية (L03; 8 between the final م and the conjunction و), من أجاز (L03), بخمسى مالها (L06).

The full stops stand between spaces (gaps as the nearest approach of the ink at 400 ppi): after سهامهم, before the bold باب (L02; 21 and 23), after الثلث, before اعلم (L03; 20 and 21), after حال, before the bold مثال (L05; 25 and 26), after سهما, before للابن (L08; 25 and 28). The note mark (١) stands in a space of 115 px between الثلث and فقياس (L07), without a full stop.

Plain alif where a hamza might be expected, as printed: اذا (L02), اعلم (L03), وابنها, وامها (L05), الابن (L06), الا (L07), اثنى, للابن (L08); with hamza: وأربعون (L01), وأجاز (L02), أكثر, أن (L03, twice), أجاز (L03), أكثر (L04), وأوصت, فأجاز (L06), وأجازت, الأم (L07), أن (L08, L10), أسهم (L09, twice), وللأم, وأنت, أن (L09); below the alif: إمرة (L05); with madda: the bold آخر (L02), ولآخر (L06); on ي: مائة (L01, twice), ثمانمائة (L01).
With tanwīn on the final alif: جميعاً (L06), شيئاً (L07); without tanwīn as printed: سهما (L01, L08), مثلا (L10).
The final yā' is printed without dots: وبقى (L01), على (L02, L05, twice), فى (L03, L04, L10, twice), بخمسى (L06), اثنى (L08), فينبغى (L10).
The print stretches ثمانمائة and سهما (L01), الحكم (L03), مالها (L06, twice) and ثلاثة (L10) with the elongation stroke; the stroke is not transcribed.

Note (١) of the editors works out the shares of the example in modern notation: the husband 3, the mother 2 and the son 7 of twelve; the two bequests together 2/5 + 1/4 = 13/20; reading the mother's half as half of her share and the husband's third as a third of his, the son pays 13/20 of his 7/12, 91/240, the husband a third of his 3/12, 1/12, the mother half of her 2/12, 1/12; the bequests together 131/240, and there remain to the son 49, to the husband 40 and to the mother 20 parts of 240. The editors call the problem obscure. The values are consistent (49 + 40 + 20 + 131 = 240). The note is not reproduced.

critical_notes.evidence: The verb is وتركت, and she left, as in the same construction on frame 085, L06 («امرأة ملكت وتركت زوجها»); the print gives its final letter three dots, as a ث, where the ت of ماتت before it in the same line has two.
critical_notes.impact: none on the mathematics: the word is clear
